title: 阿萝拉·双界长风
description: 红发兔耳阿萝拉披完整旅行外衣，在高原拱门前停步，圆眼镜、耳朵和绒尾被清亮侧光分开。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Aurora is an adult rabbit vastaya with long upright rabbit ears, red-orange hair, round spectacles, soft freckles, and a large rabbit tail. Preserve her scholarly witchlike identity, warm travel layers, and recognizable green-brown colors. A fully covering coat, opaque tights, gloves, and boots keep the figure modest; her compact wand or staff is carried quietly lowered, with no active spell.
art_direction.scene: She pauses beneath a single monumental highland arch, one foot forward but firmly grounded, looking toward an open valley where two faint benign spirit lights drift. Keep her glasses and ears clear of the silhouette. Strong cool side light and a warm reflected edge create hard wax-crayon facets on the coat, while the background recedes in broad uncluttered planes.
art_direction.palette: moss green, ginger orange, cool stone, silver-blue light
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
